limitations: This verifies a local software build, not research-data permissions or actual source compatibility.
Only required Python modules were exercised; missing optional extension modules and deliberately disabled test modules are not supported.
Source/base inputs are pinned; bit-identical rebuilds and cross-platform numerical identity are not asserted.
Live acquisition requires appropriate network/proxy/CA configuration and supported research-use context; it has not been executed.

Rebuilt 2026-10-27 from the same pinned inputs; image IDs differ from the 2026-10-25 runtime and are not interchangeable with it. Equality of the observed Python and R inventories does not establish bit-identical binaries.

rebuild.inventory_observation: Python fields observed with `docker run --rm --network none --read-only <image> /opt/python/bin/python3 -I -B -c ...`; R package versions with `Rscript -e installed.packages()` under the same isolation plus a private tmpfs /tmp. Both matched the prior record exactly.
rebuild.reason: Pinned-image rerun of the 2026-10-25 test and core changes. The R base was rebuilt with Docker 29 (containerd image store) from the same pinned inputs and validated; runtime/source-adapter-python.json was then repointed to that validated base and this image built from the committed files without --accept-rebuilt-base.

scope: Executed source-adapter software runtime build; no study data
